]> 16/08/2026 7:03 Sunny Sunday Laps and Val’s Blue Steel Rail Rumble!.

The weekend sunshine continues, with today forecast to be mostly sunny with occasional cloud, a top of 8 degrees, and light north-westerly to north-easterly winds.

It's currently -4 degrees in Perisher, and the snow guns fired up around 11:30pm last night with some still going this morning. Expect conditions to be firm and fast underfoot, with hard-packed snow base.

40 lifts are set to spin again today, and with 61 groomed runs freshly prepped, it's shaping up to be a great one for Sunday laps.

On the slopes, the Perisher Masters races continue on Front Valley this morning, while park riders have their own big day ahead with Val's Blue Steel Rail Rumble taking over the Front Valley Park. Some of Perisher's best will be throwing down for a shot at Oakley, XTM and Hydroflask gear, plus some serious cash prizes, with the Red Bull DJ Cat on hand to keep the energy up. Head to Front Valley to catch the action.

There's plenty more music around the mountain too, with Car Kills Kiwi playing Jax Bar and Vibe Band bringing the tunes to Blue Cow Bistro!

Have a great Sunday!
